Enzo Fernandez Booed by Chelsea Fans Amid Transfer Speculation

Argentine midfielder Enzo Fernandez was booed by Chelsea fans during a pre-season match. The incident occurred while Fernandez was making an appearance on the field. Reports also indicate that Manchester City is pursuing a transfer for Fernandez, and Chelsea has responded to these efforts. The specific nature of Chelsea's response to Manchester City's pursuit was not detailed.
